[{"word":"illegal","pronun":"[ɪˈliːɡl]","translation":"n. 非法移民，非法劳工

vi. 照亮","audio":"illuminate.mp3"},{"word":"illusion","pronun":"[ɪˈluːʒn]","translation":"n. 幻觉，错觉；错误的观念或信仰","audio":"illusion.mp3"},{"word":"illustrate","pronun":"[ˈɪləstreɪt]","translation":"vi. 举例
vt. 阐明，举例说明；图解","audio":"illustrate.mp3"},{"word":"imaginary","pronun":"[ɪˈmædʒɪneri]","translation":"adj. 虚构的，假想的；想像的；虚数的","audio":"imaginary.mp3"},{"word":"imaginative","pronun":"[ɪˈmædʒɪnətɪv]","translation":"adj. 富于想象的；有创造力的","audio":"imaginative.mp3"},{"word":"imitate","pronun":"[ˈɪmɪteɪt]","translation":"vt. 模仿，仿效；仿造，仿制","audio":"imitate.mp3"},{"word":"imitation","pronun":"[ˌɪmɪˈteɪʃn]","translation":"n. 模仿，仿造；仿制品
adj. 人造的，仿制的","audio":"imitation.mp3"},{"word":"immense","pronun":"[ɪˈmens]","translation":"adj. 巨大的，广大的；无边无际的；非常好的","audio":"immense.mp3"},{"word":"immerse","pronun":"[ɪˈmɜːrs]","translation":"vt. 沉浸；使陷入","audio":"immerse.mp3"},{"word":"immigrant","pronun":"[ˈɪmɪɡrənt]","translation":"n. 移民，侨民
adj. 移民的；迁入的","audio":"immigrant.mp3"},{"word":"immune","pronun":"[ɪˈmjuːn]","translation":"n. 免疫者；免除者
adj. 免疫的；免于……的，免除的","audio":"immune.mp3"},{"word":"impact","pronun":"[ˈɪmpækt]","translation":"vi. 影响；撞击；冲突；压紧（on，upon，with）
n. 影响；效果；碰撞；冲击力
vt. 挤入，压紧；撞击；对…产生影响","audio":"impact.mp3"},{"word":"impair","pronun":"[ɪmˈper]","translation":"vt. 损害；削弱；减少","audio":"impair.mp3"},{"word":"impart","pronun":"[ɪmˈpɑːrt]","translation":"vt. 给予（尤指抽象事物），传授；告知，透露","audio":"impart.mp3"},{"word":"impatient","pronun":"[ɪmˈpeɪʃnt]","translation":"adj. 焦躁的；不耐心的","audio":"impatient.mp3"},{"word":"imperative","pronun":"[ɪmˈperətɪv]","translation":"n. 必要的事；命令；需要；规则；[语]祈使语气
